simpleJp: BATTLE 8-2「白き死の運び手」で敵を全滅させる
enGuide: Defeat all enemies. Several malformed angels use temporary physical or magic barriers; wait out the barrier CT when necessary and watch for the wide-area 「制裁の光」.

simpleJp: BATTLE 8-3「永劫の律を守る者」でテリオスを倒す
enGuide: Defeat Terios. After the battle, talk to the clown twice when free action resumes to receive the missable 「火霊のピアス」.
